test_person_search.title: Verify Person search with Male description returns results

steps.action: Open Search, choose Category Person and Description Male, pick the configured site and cameras, and pick a duration.

steps.expected: At least one Person result appears in the result grid.

test_person_search_results_valid.title: Verify Person search results contain valid images

steps.action: Open Search and run a Person/Male search for the configured site over a duration.
steps.expected: Person results appear in the result grid.

steps.action: Look at the first result's image.
steps.expected: Its picture is a decoded blob, data or http image with a width above zero.

test_person_search_play_result.title: Verify a Person search result plays to its end

steps.action: On Search, pick the Person category, the Male description, the site's cameras and a duration, then search.

steps.expected: The clip plays and the Replay icon shows when it ends.

steps.action: Open Search, choose Category Vehicle (it has no description filter), pick the configured site and cameras, and pick a duration.

steps.expected: At least one Vehicle result appears in the result grid.

test_vehicle_search_play_result.title: Verify a Vehicle search result plays to its end

steps.action: On Search, pick the Vehicle category, the site's cameras and a duration, then search.

steps.expected: The clip plays and the Replay icon shows when it ends.

test_event_search.title: Verify Event category search returns results

steps.action: Open Search, choose Category Event, pick the configured site and cameras, and pick a duration.

steps.expected: At least one Event result appears in the result grid.

test_event_search_play_result.title: Verify playing an Event search result clip works

steps.action: Open Search, run an Event search for the configured site over a duration.
steps.expected: Event results appear in the result grid.
The clip plays, and a Replay control appears when it ends.
